decisions.reason: Still presented on its own page, showing sustained visible commitment and no clear non-temporary failure, so escalation of commitment favors keeping it.
Reduced from its own page to a mere mention signals weakened public commitment and disappointing results that are unlikely to be temporary, making dropping consistent with escalation logic.
